subject: Request to reschedule our call
text: Hello Professor, I am writing to ask whether we can reschedule our call later this week. I had planned to be fully prepared, but an unanticipated expense came up overnight and requires me to visit the financial aid office during the slot we originally discussed. The cost is for required course materials that arrived with a missing access code, and the replacement charge was not covered by the purchase price. I apologize for the late notice and any inconvenience. I can still speak with you briefly before class on Thursday, or I can meet you Friday between noon and four if that is easier. Please let me know which option works for you. If neither time is suitable, I am happy to adjust around your availability. Thank you for your understanding, and I will bring the relevant notes and questions to our new time. I will keep the call focused and brief so it does not take up more time than necessary.
